messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: routing_service: high error rate detected for route /v1/generate (policy: new-schema-release)
incident-bot: Symptoms: 5xx spike, increased p95 latency, abnormal regional failovers. Pager sent to #incidents and oncall.

sara_oncall: Paging team — I see a sudden jump in 500s starting ~3329001200. Root cause looks like routing policy decided variant=heavy-eu for many routes.

lee_prod: Confirming. 5xx up from 0.3% -> 8% in the last 4m. Latency p95 jumped to 2.4s. Some customers on us-east report timeouts.

michael_support: Support notes: 3 customers (enterprise) reported errors in-chat, they see higher token costs too. Flagging for customer impact assessment.

sara_oncall: @devin_sre can you triage? I tried reading the policy rollout logs, looks like the schema migration removed fallback_variant but code now treats missing field as explicit 'heavy-eu' due to legacy mapping.

devin_sre: On it. grabbing logs.

devin_sre: Quick log snip:
```
[router] 3329001231 interpret_policy: schema_version=2 -> mapping: fallback_variant not found, legacy_field 'route.default_variant' present -> map to 'heavy-eu'
[router] 3329001232 route_assign: user=svc-123 model=redwood-7b variant=heavy-eu region=eu-west
[dispatch] 3329001240 capacity_check: region eu-west saturated, trigger fallback -> next region chosen: eu-west (loop)
```

eva_engineer: Whoa, a mapping loop. The mapping function didn't account for the new enum. When capacity full, the fallback routing logic keeps picking the same region because variant==heavy-eu pins region.

sara_oncall: Impact summary so far: widespread latency/5xx increase, EU compute overloaded, cascade caused US customers to be routed and then failback. Potential cost spike and customer errors. Need mitigation asap.

devin_sre: Mitigation plan proposal:
1) Pause new-schema rollout flag (console) to stop new policy interpretation.
2) Force override routing for /v1/generate to variant=light-us for critical customers.
3) Apply circuit-breaker: reject traffic to heavy-eu for non-enterprise tenants.
4) Revert mapping in router code to treat missing legacy field as 'no-op' instead of defaulting to heavy-eu.

lee_prod: I can pause the rollout from console — doing it now. @ops-bot please run: `/ops pause-rollout routing/new-schema-release` and confirm.

ops-bot: Command accepted. Rollout routing/new-schema-release paused by lee_prod at 3329001305.

michael_support: Applying customer mitigation: adding per-tenant override for the 3 affected enterprises -> variant=light-us. Informing account managers.

eva_engineer: Pushing a hotfix to router to short-circuit legacy mapping now (will deploy to canary in 2m). Patch: change legacy fallback to return null unless explicit mapping found.

devin_sre: In the meantime, I've inserted an emergency policy via the console for route /v1/generate: `routing.override_variant=light-us` for global default. This should steer bulk traffic out of eu-west.

sara_oncall: Good. Monitor metrics. @devin_sre can you confirm TTL on override and rollback plan?

devin_sre: Override TTL set to 1h. Rollback: remove override once eu-west queue drains and p95 falls < 500ms for 5m.

lee_prod: Metrics: error-rate dropping, eu-west CPU from 98% -> 72% in last 4m, p95 down to 1.1s. We're trending good.

michael_support: Notified customers of mitigation. One asks for detailed RCA — we'll follow up after postmortem.

sara_oncall: Handoff: I'm 60m into shift, will hand to @devin_sre for remainder of the incident. Key actions for next oncall:
- Keep override in place until router patch is live and validated.
- Coordinate with product to revert schema change or publish compatibility shim.
- Customer comms team will draft notice.

devin_sre: Acknowledged. I'll take over. Current action items I own: deploy router canary, verify mapping fix, monitor failover loops.

eva_engineer: Canary deployed at 3329001500 to 5% of traffic. No repeat of legacy mapping observed in canary logs.

devin_sre: After 10m, canary looks clean. Rolling to 50% then full in 15m if stable.

ops-bot: Routing patch deployed to 50% at 3329001620.

devin_sre: Full deploy complete at 3329001720. Removing emergency override now.

ops-bot: Override removed by devin_sre at 3329001730.

lee_prod: Final checks: error-rate back to baseline 0.4%, p95 stable 420ms, cost spike contained. Opening incident postmortem ticket.

michael_support: Noted affected customers and next steps for outreach. Will join postmortem.

sara_oncall: Thanks all. Incident severity: Sev2. Root cause: schema migration created ambiguous mapping for deprecated legacy field 'route.default_variant' which defaulted to a heavyweight EU variant. This caused region pinning and fallback loops when capacity saturated.

sara_oncall: Next steps (post-incident):
- Add automated lint to schema migration to fail on unmapped deprecated fields.
- Update docs on default semantics for removed fields.
- Retro and customer comms.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: routing_service high error rate mitigated. Duration ~30m. Postmortem ticket: PT-4821. Please add notes.

sara_oncall: closing handoff. @devin_sre take lead on postmortem. Thanks everyone :tada:
